name: Yield Basis
description: Curve-team protocol on Ethereum that gives BTC/ETH LPs (WBTC, cbBTC, tBTC, WETH) a 2x-leveraged Curve crvUSD-pool position designed to cancel impermanent loss. Agents deposit the asset into a market's LT to get yb-LP shares (yb-WBTC, yb-cbBTC, yb-tBTC, yb-WETH), withdraw, optionally stake shares in the gauge for YB emissions, lock YB as veYB, vote gauges and claim veYB fees.

keyFunctions.description: Number of deployed markets (11 on 2026-11-25: indexes 0-10; 7-10 active, 0-6 deprecated).

Market struct (asset_token, cryptopool, amm (LEVAMM), lt (yb-LP token / vault), price_oracle, virtual_pool, staker (gauge)). Onchain state does not flag deprecated markets; compare with the contract-addresses page.
Curve Emergency DAO multisig that can kill/revive a market.
FeeSplitter that receives LT admin fees.

contracts.name: yb-WBTC (LT, market 7: WBTC, 2x leveraged WBTC/crvUSD Curve LP)

keyFunctions.description: Deposit WBTC and mint yb-WBTC shares. Args (assets in raw WBTC units, 8 decimals; debt = crvUSD the LEVAMM borrows, raw 18-decimal units; min_shares (18 decimals) slippage floor; receiver). Approve WBTC (0x2260FAC5E5542a773Aa44fBCfeDf7C193bc2C599) to this LT first. Not ERC-4626 despite the event names. Pool policy: YBTwocryptoPolicy (use the price rule: debt = assets * pool.price_oracle() // 10**8). Pool = 0x313698667d7FDD6789a9BC70821309ff891E729A, LEVAMM = 0x7b9817eb5C49A99875138A5d52bF64a8B2cFFFFE. Reverts 'Debt too high' when the deposit would exceed the market cap (AMM.max_debt()/2), 'Deposit to staker' if receiver is the gauge (use StakeZap to deposit+stake). Simulate before sending.
Expected shares for (assets, debt). Does not run the LT deviation check; reverts 'Debt too high' over the cap.

Burn shares and receive WBTC: (shares, min_assets in raw WBTC units, receiver). Unstake from the gauge first (reverts 'Withdraw to/from staker'). Give a gas margin (reverts 'GAS' if the gauge checkpoint retry lacks 200k gas). If the market is killed: 'We're dead. Use emergency_withdraw'.
Redemption Value: WBTC (raw units) you would get now for a share amount, including the Temporary Redemption Discount (TRD). Use it to set min_assets.

Fundamental Value of one share in WBTC, scaled to 18 decimals regardless of asset decimals (oracle-based; excludes TRD and is not an upper bound). TRD = preview_withdraw(1e18) * 10**(18-8) / pricePerShare() - 1.

Exit when the market is killed or its oracle reverts: (shares, receiver, owner). Returns (asset_out, stables_to_return int256); if negative you must pay that much crvUSD, so approve crvUSD (0xf939E0A03FB07F59A73314E73794Be0E57ac1b4E) to this LT first. No slippage parameter.
Quote (asset_received, stables_to_return) for emergency_withdraw.
True if the market is killed (then only emergency_withdraw works).
yb-WBTC share balance (18 decimals). Staked shares sit in the gauge and are not counted here.
ERC-20 approve, e.g. let the gauge pull shares before staking.

Stake yb-WBTC: (LT shares, receiver); mints gauge shares (ERC-4626 style). Approve this gauge on the LT first. Staked positions earn YB emissions instead of Fundamental Value growth and carry watermark risk.
Unstake an exact amount of LT shares: (assets, receiver, owner).
Unstake by gauge shares: (shares, receiver, owner); returns LT shares.
Claim rewards: (reward token, user). Use YB 0x01791F726B4103694969820be083196cC7c045fF for emissions; claim() with no args claims YB for msg.sender.
Claimable amount of a reward token for a user (raw units).
LT shares for a gauge-share amount (includes the pending staker rebase; can be below 1:1).
LT shares a redeem would return.
Gauge share balance (18 decimals).

Deposit and stake in one tx: (gauge, assets, debt, min_shares (LT shares, not gauge shares), receiver). Approve the asset to the zap. debt follows the same pool-policy rule as LT.deposit. Returns gauge shares.
Unstake and withdraw in one tx: (gauge, gauge shares, min_assets (raw asset units), receiver). Approve the gauge shares to the zap first. Returns asset amount.
YB balance (18 decimals). Max supply 1,000,000,000 YB; minted only via GaugeController emissions.
Approve veYB (VotingEscrow) before create_lock / increase_amount.
ERC-20 transfer.
Lock YB: (amount raw 18-dec, unlock unix time). Unlock time is rounded down to a week and must be <= now + 4 years. Approve YB first. Mints a veYB NFT; one lock per address.
Add YB to an existing, unexpired lock (two-arg form increase_amount(uint256,address) adds to another address's lock).
Extend the unlock time (rounded down to a week, max 4 years ahead).
Toggle permalock (no decay). Turning it off requires no active gauge votes and restarts a 4-year decay.
Withdraw all YB after the lock expired (permalocks must be toggled off first).
Current voting power (18 decimals); decays linearly to the unlock time. balanceOf() is the NFT count, not voting power.
(amount, end) of an address's lock.
Vote YB emissions to gauges with your veYB: (gauges, weights in basis points, total <= 10000). Max 50 gauges; at most once per gauge every 10 days; lock must not be expired.
Share of emissions a gauge gets (1e18 = 100%).
Raw gauge weight.
Number of gauges; gauges(i) lists them.
YB a gauge will have received by a timestamp (18 decimals).
Claim weekly admin fees (paid as yb-LP tokens) for veYB: (receiver, epoch_count (max 50 per call, default 50), use_vest false for normal users). claim() with no args claims for msg.sender.
Tokens and amounts a claim would pay; marked non-view in the ABI, call it with eth_call.
Anyone: spread newly received fees over the next 4 weekly epochs.

actions.name: find-market
actions.how: Factory.markets(i) for i in 7..10 (active) -> (asset, cryptopool, amm, lt, price_oracle, virtual_pool, staker). Check LT.is_killed() == false.

actions.name: deposit
actions.how: 1) Read pool.POLICY(); compute debt with the price rule (assets * pool.price_oracle() // 10**asset_decimals) on YBTwocryptoPolicy pools (WBTC, cbBTC, tBTC), or with the LEVAMM-book rule on the WETH pool (live YBOraclizedPolicy). 2) expected = LT.preview_deposit(assets, debt); min_shares = expected * (1 - tolerance). 3) asset.approve(LT, assets). 4) Simulate then send LT.deposit(assets, debt, min_shares, receiver).

actions.name: withdraw
actions.how: If staked, unstake first (gauge.redeem or StakeZap.withdraw_and_unstake). expected = LT.preview_withdraw(shares); compare with pricePerShare to see the TRD; LT.withdraw(shares, expected * (1 - tolerance), receiver) with a gas margin.

actions.name: deposit-and-stake
actions.description: Deposit and stake for YB emissions in one tx
actions.how: asset.approve(StakeZap, assets); StakeZap.deposit_and_stake(gauge, assets, debt, min_shares, receiver).

actions.name: claim-yb
actions.how: gauge.claim(YB, user) or gauge.claim(); preview with gauge.preview_claim(YB, user).

actions.name: lock-yb
actions.how: YB.approve(veYB, amount); veYB.create_lock(amount, unlockTime <= now + 4y). Then GaugeController.vote_for_gauge_weights([gauges],[bps]) and FeeDistributor.claim() weekly.

risks: Leverage: each market holds a 2x-leveraged Curve LP position funded by pooled crvUSD debt (target ~50% debt). Arbitrage keeps it on target; in fast markets or gas spikes leverage can drift. Borrow rate is set by the DAO per market (up to 100%/yr).
Withdrawals can realise a Temporary Redemption Discount (TRD): preview_withdraw can be below pricePerShare for hours to weeks; always set min_assets from preview_withdraw.

Caps: deposits revert 'Debt too high' when a market's LEVAMM would exceed AMM.max_debt()/2 (limited by crvUSD allocation); deposits can also revert 'Unsafe min/max' or 'LT deviation' (WETH oracle-report pool).

Staked positions give up Fundamental Value growth for YB emissions and have a watermark: after losses staked shares can redeem below the deposit until gains close the gap. YB price and gauge weight drive the return.

Kill switch: Factory admin or the Curve Emergency DAO can kill a market; then only emergency_withdraw works and you may have to repay part of the debt in crvUSD from your wallet. If the oracle reverts while not killed, staked holders cannot unstake.

Dependencies: Curve Twocrypto pools, crvUSD (depeg risk), the crvUSD price aggregator, Pyth price reports on the WETH pool's YBOraclizedPolicy, and the wrapped-asset issuers (WBTC/cbBTC custodians, tBTC bridge).

New protocol (mainnet launch September 2025; markets 0-6 already deprecated and replaced). Core contracts are immutable (not upgradeable). Audits: Statemind, ChainSecurity, Quantstamp, Electisec, Pashov, MixBytes (DAO, Hybrid Vaults), Firepan AI (FeeDistributor), Sherlock contest; audits do not remove all risk.
veYB locks are up to 4 years (or permanent) and cannot be withdrawn early.
notes: All addresses from the official contract-addresses page (docs.yieldbasis.com/user/reference/contract-addresses) and cross-checked onchain: Factory.markets(7..10) return exactly the listed LTs and gauges, and each LT.staker() is the listed gauge. Function signatures from the official yb-core GitHub source (Vyper) and the dev docs; Vyper default arguments also create shorter overloads (e.g. deposit(uint256,uint256,uint256), withdraw(uint256,uint256), claim()). Only active markets 7-10 are listed; deprecated markets 0-6 (old yb-WBTC/yb-cbBTC/yb-tBTC/yb-WETH tokens) are on the same page under 'Deprecated markets' — move positions with LTMigrator 0xd5b450fDD5aF5341436Fc37A46BBEc39CA8F92CB. 'ybBTC' is a marketing name; the onchain share tokens are yb-WBTC, yb-cbBTC and yb-tBTC (I found no separate ybBTC token address in the docs; the ybBTC docs page linked from llms.txt returns 404). Left out on purpose: LEVAMM, VirtualPool, LP oracles, pool policies, Hybrid Vaults (HybridVaultFactory 0xBdC32268851C324c6185809271dfe6d8dab8dC5b, crvUSD-backed vaults across up to 16 markets), net-pressure and lending-oracle contracts, vesting escrows and the Aragon DAO — all on the contract-addresses page. YB LPs and pools trade on Curve; use Curve for YB swaps.
